Description

Downhills Park in North London offers an excellent place to play rugby. Anyone looking to play rugby or train in North London should head on down to take advantage of the fabulous rugby facilities at Downhills Park. Staff keep the surface in good order so it’s possible to use it through all seasons. The pitch can be used for various rugby disciplines. Rugby Union and Rugby League remain the most popular versions of the sport, but there are some new formats that are gaining huge interest. Tag Rugby and Touch rugby are ideal ways to enjoy rugby without the physicality and can be played at this venue. These forms of the game are also great for mixed rugby too.

If public transport isn't your thing, then parking facilities are available where a pay and display system is operated. The specific prices may vary depending on the time of day, so if you'd like to know this information then please contact the venue.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off game isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Downhills Park? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly game and socialise with your friends.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Turnpike Lane Tube. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
